request: Create a small Python command-line tool, wordfreq, that prints the ten most frequent words in a text file, case-insensitively and ignoring punctuation. Package it under src/wordfreq with a console entry point, and test it with pytest. The work is done when python -m pytest passes.

task.title: Create the wordfreq package, its CLI and tests
task.action: Write src/wordfreq/__init__.py with count_words(text) and top_words(path, n), src/wordfreq/cli.py with main(), a [project.scripts] entry in pyproject.toml, and tests/test_wordfreq.py

plan.title: Add a Flask dashboard that draws word clouds
plan.action: Add a Flask web app under web/ that uploads a file and renders a word cloud
plan.motivation: Users may like a visual view
